# @three-ws/kol-mcp

> Track one smart trader from any AI agent — a tracked KOL wallet's portfolio P&L (realized/unrealized, win rate, top holding) and its trades on a given mint. Read-only over the live public three.ws KOL API. No key, no signer, no payment.

@three-ws/kol-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/kol-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/kol-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/kol-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/kol-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/kol-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
